entries.title: Psalms 110:1
segments: ¶<A Psalm. Of David.> The Lord said to my lord, Be seated at my right hand, till I put all those who are against you under your feet.

entries.title: Psalms 110:2
segments: The Lord will send out the rod of your strength from Zion; be king over your haters.

entries.title: Psalms 110:3
segments: Your people give themselves gladly in the day of your power; like the dew of the morning on the holy mountains is the army of your young men.

entries.title: Psalms 110:4
segments: The Lord has made an oath, and will not take it back. You are a priest for ever, after the order of Melchizedek.

entries.title: Psalms 110:5
segments: ¶In the day of his wrath kings will be wounded by the Lord at your right hand.

entries.title: Psalms 110:6
segments: He will be judge among the nations, the valleys will be full of dead bodies; the head over a great country will be wounded by him.

entries.title: Psalms 110:7
segments: He will take of the stream by the way; so his head will be lifted up.
